tests.name: Initial normal deck matches AT combat state before and after one action
Selection order cannot reorder the initial draw or combat RNG
One owned copy cannot fill two slots; the rejected edit is atomic
Choosing an equivalent possession cannot reorder distinct variants or redraw the combat seed
Variants share the base cap, including normal cards
Two separately owned variants may fill two allowed base slots
An old unlock alone does not supply a free reward-base card
Selected cards cannot be sold; last-copy sale removes use but keeps knowledge
Preparation, departure, refill and defeat cannot mint or remove existing possessions
A consumed acquired healing instance can be prepared again with no replenishment cost
An active deck cannot be edited, and stale save references are rejected
Restoration rejects changed acquired card effects and a missing variant cost map
A real AT purchase can enter the deck and preserve its exact affixes in a resumed exploration
